caption: The drawing is rendered in grayscale pencil on off-white paper and depicts three objects arranged within a rectangular border. The two larger objects are horizontally oriented and positioned parallel to each other: the upper object is a curved-blade knife with a rounded tip and a contoured handle that appears textured or decorated with grooves and faceted surfaces. Beneath it, the second object is a two-tined carving fork with a similar handle design, also elongated and decorated with facets and grooves. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is an oval-shaped object displayed from a top-down perspective; this object features a central, almond-shaped element surrounded by radiating, leaf-like patterns arranged symmetrically around the main axis. The lines are precise and detailed, showing shading to indicate volume and texture, with some areas darker to emphasize contours. The entire composition is contained within a single-line border, with faint signs of aging or discoloration visible near the right edge of the paper.
title: Silver Knife and Fork
